title: Gemini API Chat Schema
description: Interact with the Gemini API via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint

prompt.description: The user prompt/message to send to the AI model

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to guide the AI's behavior

response_format.description: Expected response format - 'text' for plain text or 'json' for structured JSON

model.description: Model to use (use any OpenAI-compatible Gemini model exposed by your host)

api_host.description: Optional override for the Gemini API base URL (defaults to profile BASE_URL or https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/)

temperature.description: Controls randomness. Higher values mean more random, lower values more deterministic

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling parameter. Consider tokens with top_p probability mass

frequency_penalty.description: Penalizes new tokens based on their frequency in the text so far

presence_penalty.description: Penalizes new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far

response_format.description: Raw OpenAI response_format payload for advanced control

response.description: The raw text response from the AI model

raw_response.description: Raw completion text (identical to response for text mode)

model.description: Model actually used for the call

parse_success.description: Indicates if JSON parsing succeeded when response_format=json

profile.description: Requires AI credentials profile with API_KEY and (optionally) BASE_URL that points to the Gemini-compatible host.
